summary: Fold now maps full-width U+FF01..FF5E to ASCII, strips accents in U+00C0..U+017F via a 192-byte table (kept letters lower-cased), drops U+0300..U+036F, and lower-cases as strings.ToLower with an ASCII fast path. Rank reuses a once-built folded-title token cache (same BM25 scores/order, skips 8000 folds per query); Quote compares promos with an alloc-free fold-aware matcher (ASCII fast path incl. ete25/noel50/vip20). Safe for concurrent use (sync.Once, no globals mutated); bench: Rank 6.10ms->1.78ms (-71%), Quote 106ns->101ns, allocs 16010->9 and 0->0, so own time per visit drops on both services.
